{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
top_rows = sales_df.head()

# Display data types and missing values
info = sales_df.info()

# Check for duplicates
dups = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Summary of customer_segment
segment_summary = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Summary of conversion status
conversion_summary = sales_df['converted'].value_counts()

# Print results
top_rows, info, dups, segment_summary, conversion_summary"}
